when.en: An existing surface is rebuilt: composition, region order, hierarchy or responsive structure change while business facts, behaviour and API semantics stay.
when.vi: Dựng lại một bề mặt đã có: đổi composition, thứ tự vùng, hierarchy hay cấu trúc responsive trong khi fact nghiệp vụ, hành vi và API giữ nguyên.

mission.goal: an existing surface is rebuilt, proven and published

doneWhen.evidence: the surface is committed on the session branch
the committed head is served on the product port
the served surface passes the audit with its screenshots kept
a person's journey completes on the served surface
the session branch is merged and pushed

rewrite: frontend trio → interface.generate (changeLevel reconstruct); post-write bind → runtime.serve; frontend.surface.audit → interface.audit.
